data.name: Biltur Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Biltur: Realistic Driving Simulator (Early Access)

Get Behind the Wheel. Gain Real-World Confidence. Start Your Journey.

Tired of dry, boring driving lessons? Biltur is the realistic driving simulator built to prepare you for the road, without the pressure of real-world traffic. Whether you're a curious beginner (Ages 10+) learning the basics of car control, a teen prepping for your first lessons, or an adult looking to safely brush up on road rules, Biltur is your ultimate practice partner.

For the New Learner (Ages 10+ & Teens)

  • Realism Meets Fun: Experience car physics and handling that strives for realism. Feel the force feedback that imitates the tires gripping the asphalt and the momentum that shifts in every turn. We aim to be one of the most realistic car rides you can take from your desk.

  • Master the Controls: Practice the fundamentals at your own pace. Perfect steering precision, gentle braking, and smooth acceleration before you ever sit in a real driver's seat.

  • The Full Traffic Challenge: Our dynamic AI traffic system replicates real-world behaviors; from careful commuters to aggressive drivers, unexpected pedestrians, or even moose! Learn to anticipate, react, and make safe decisions in dense, realistic city and rural environments.

  • Conquer Tricky Maneuvers: Perfect three-point turns, parking with a backup camera, and navigating roundabouts in a risk-free environment. Retry complex scenarios until they become second nature.

For Parents & The Focused Adult

  • Zero-Risk Training: Provide your future driver with a safe, controlled environment to make mistakes and learn from them. There's no damage, no real-world cost, and no risk to property or people.

  • Real-World Traffic Simulation: Our focus is on the reality of driving. Practice merging onto highways, handling rush-hour congestion, and following road signs and signals with professional-grade accuracy.

  • Built for Real Driving: Unlike arcade racers, Biltur uses a precision-tuned physics engine to focus on the weight, feel, and response of an everyday vehicle, giving you true-road muscle memory.

  • Comprehensive Environments: Drive through cities, quiet suburbs, and challenging rural roads, experiencing variable weather (rain, snow) and day/night cycles to ensure practice under all conditions.

Early Access Disclaimer

Biltur is currently in Early Access. This means the core driving experience, physics, and traffic systems have been prioritized first, while some content (like specific weather conditions or detailed situations and lessons) is still in development.

  • Currently Included:

    • Daylight driving with fair weather.

    • One map with a small city area, a highway, and rural area.

    • Varied speed limits.

    • Traffic signs used on real roads.

  • Future Plans: We plan to introduce more complex weather systems (Rain, Snow), more distinct environments, and expanded, structured situations based on community feedback.

Your feedback directly shapes our roadmap, helping us prioritize and deliver the most impactful features for the final release!

Key Features:

  • Realistic Physics

  • Full Support for Steering Wheels, Pedals,  Handles, and Shifters

  • Dynamic AI Traffic and Pedestrian Systems

  • City & Rural Environments

Biltur: Stop just thinking about driving. Start practicing.

data.short_description: Biltur is an Early Access driving simulation focused on authentic traffic and realistic car physics, providing essential, zero-pressure training for new and experienced drivers to master road rules and control.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 3090 / RX 6900 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-14700F / AMD Ryzen 7 7700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 4070-S / RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
